mechanism: Furosemide-induced hypokalemia and volume depletion can potentiate orthostatic hypotension and reduce levodopa efficacy, while levodopa may cause hypotension that is worsened by concurrent diuretic use.
action: Monitor blood pressure, serum potassium, and parkinsonian symptom control; consider potassium supplementation and ensure adequate hydration; adjust levodopa dosing if necessary.
